methodology.scoring: Score is a 0–100 weighted mean. Default weights: coverage 35%, exchange-native liquidity percentile 35%, liquid exchange count 15%, major quote availability 10%, activity 5%. Configured weights are renormalized only across available components.
methodology.missingData: Missing exchange fields remain omitted. Missing volume is excluded from liquidity ranking; unavailable components are omitted and weights renormalized, and discovery failures are reported rather than interpreted as zero markets.
methodology.volumeAggregation: Quote volumes are ranked only within the same exchange and quote currency. Totals are summed by quote currency; totalVolume24h and medianVolume24h are null unless all available listings use one quote currency with reported volume. No cross-currency conversion is assumed.
methodology.stablecoinClassification: Known stablecoin/fiat quote symbols are classified separately; all discovered quote currencies are retained. Stablecoin base assets are excluded from ranked assets.
methodology.marketLiquidityDisclaimer: 24-hour exchange-reported volume is a discovery-ranking signal, not executable order-book liquidity or a guarantee of arbitrage execution.
